danger.title: Delete your account
danger.body: Erases your account and every workspace you own alone. A workspace you own that other people use has to be handed to another member, or deleted, first.

delete_workspace.title: Delete workspace
delete_workspace.body: This erases {name} for everyone in it: tasks, projects and their clones, chats, credentials, webhooks and API keys. It cannot be undone.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.body: Hand {name} to another member. They become its owner and you stay on as an admin.
transfer.no_members: Nobody else is in this workspace. Invite someone first.

delete_account.title: Delete your account
delete_account.body: This erases your account, your sessions and every workspace you own alone. API keys you created stop working. It cannot be undone.

rename.title: Rename workspace
rename.body: Members see the new name in the workspace menu and on invitations. The slug stays the same, so links and sign-in settings keep working.
rename.label: Name
rename.too_long: The name can have at most {max} characters.
